paragraphs.text: Meshy 3D generation and 3D printing skills for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
# Meshy for DeepSeek Harness
English | 中文

Meshy's 3D generation and 3D printing skills for DeepSeek Harness
(dsh). The agent drives `meshy-cli

` through its shell
tool and saves the results into your project: text or image to 3D, textures, rem

eshing, rigging
and animation, format conversion, and print-ready files with slicer handoff.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`dsh --profile web --dump-config` now shows a `# == meshy-dsh` layer, and typing `/` in `dsh web`
li

sts `meshy-3d-generation` and `meshy-3d-printing` in a new session. Plugins belong to one
profile: i

nstall into each one you use (`web`, `tui`, `desktop`). Then ask for a model, for example "make a
lo

w-poly treasure chest and export FBX". The agent checks the CLI, asks you to sign in if needed,
show
s the cost and waits for your confirmation before it spends credits.

The plugin ships the Meshy CLI and keeps your sign-in itself: dsh runs the agent's shell in a
sandbo

x that cannot save a login, so the plugin signs in, refreshes the session on its side and
hands it t

o every shell call. Sign in once — from **Settings → Meshy**, or in a chat, where the
agent shows yo

u a link and a code (the `meshy_sign_in` tool) — and every session, new or old, is
signed in; nothin

g is installed or downloaded per session. Choose the China site to sign in at
meshy.cn with the same

account and the same credits, and keep calls there. The sign-in is the CLI's own (encrypted under
a

key your OS keeps), so `meshy` in your terminal shares it. dsh keeps an exported `MESHY_API_KEY`
ou
t of the agent's shell, and the plugin does not pass it on either.
## Update

dsh never updates a plugin it installed, so you keep the version you added until you reinstall it.
I

n Web and Desktop, the Meshy page and **Settings → Meshy** say when a newer version is out, and a
do

t appears on the sidebar entry. A release shows up there once it is a day old: until then dsh's
inst

aller would still pick the previous one. To update, uninstall Meshy on its page under
**Plugins** an

d add `meshy-dsh` again; from a terminal, `dsh plugin --profile web remove meshy-dsh`
followed by th
e `add` command above. You stay signed in.
## Settings page and 3D preview

In Web and Desktop, a **Meshy** entry appears in the left sidebar. It opens a Meshy page with your
a

ccount and a few example requests: pick one and a new session opens with it filled in, ready to
edit

and send. **Settings → Meshy** (also the plugin's page under **Plugins**) shows the
plugin and Mesh

y CLI versions, whether and how you are signed in (browser or API key), the account, which
site (mes

hy.ai or meshy.cn) and your credits. The account (name and email) appears once you sign
in with this
version; the China site does not report it yet. **Sign in to Meshy** shows the approval link with a

QR code for your phone and the code
to check; the page picks up the approval by itself. Clicking a

`.glb` file in the right sidebar, or
the card of a model the agent delivers, opens an interactive 3D

preview (drag to orbit, scroll to
zoom, reset the view or let it turn) with its file size and trian

gle count. Models up to 256 MB
open, past dsh's 32 MB limit for previewing a whole file, because the

preview reads them in 2 MB
pieces. tui and headless have
neither; the skills work the same everywhe

eview reads them in 2 MB
pieces. tui and headless have
neither; the skills work the same everywhere.
## How it works

`cordis.patch.yml` mounts one more instance of dsh's built-in filesystem
skill provider over this pa

ckage's `skills/` directory, so the skills load like any local skill,
and loads the package itself:

`lib/index.js` keeps the sign-in fresh and gives every shell call
the CLI this package depends on (`

DSH_MESHY_NODE`, `DSH_MESHY_CLI`), the session
(`DSH_MESHY_CREDENTIAL`, `DSH_MESHY_REGION`, `DSH_MES

HY_SUBJECT`, never the refresh token) and a
`.meshy` directory in the session's workspace for the CL

I's operation journal
(`DSH_MESHY_STATE_DIR`); it registers the `meshy_sign_in` tool, and in Web and

Desktop serves four
authenticated routes that run the CLI with fixed arguments. `lib/client.js` (bu

ilt from `src/client/`)
is the browser half, with three.js in a separate `lib/client.viewer.js` load

ed on first use. A skill of the same name in
your project's `.dsh/skills` or `.agents/skills` takes

precedence. `locale/` and `icon.svg` are
what dsh's Plugin Manager shows.

`skills/` is a copy of the CLI skills in
meshy-3d-agent, which owns them and serves every
other agen
t host. Change them there.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

To take new skills: release meshy-3d-agent, set `meshy.skills` in `package.json` to its tag, run
`no
de scripts/sync-skills.mjs`, and bump the version.
## Release

Bump `version` in `package.json` and add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, then create a GitHub Release
tagged

`v<version>` and run `publish.yml` from `main` with that
tag. It checks the tag against `package.js

on`, runs the checks above and publishes with
provenance through npm trusted publishing (GitHub OIDC

), so no npm token is stored anywhere.
Do not publish by hand.
